title: Singapore Polytechnic Graduation
text: I graduated from Singapore Polytechnic with a Diploma in Information Technology, specializing in UI/UX design. Three years of modules, projects, a hackathon and an internship at Amber Creative all led up to this moment, walking across the stage to receive my diploma!
